column1: # Custom liver-cancer signatures not in MSigDB. One row per gene; lines starting with # are ignored.
# Fill from the papers' supplementary tables (never from memory). Set names are referenced in
# config/subtype_signatures.yaml as "custom:<set>". Direction "dn" rows become set "custom:<set>_DN".
#   Gao et al., Cell 2019 (Tables S3, S5, S7; scripts/tools/extract_gao2019_signatures.py): GAO2019_* sets.
#     Proteomic subgroups 1/2/3 are NOT in these tables (expected in Table S1/S2, not yet provided).
#   Desert et al., Hepatology 2017 - already in MSigDB (DESERT_*_HEPATOCELLULAR_CARCINOMA_SUBCLASS_UP).
#   TCGA Cell 2017 iClusters - per-sample labels in the TCGA PanCan clinical file (SUBTYPE column); use as an annotation.
#   Montironi et al., Gut 2023 (inflamed / intermediate / excluded immune classes)
#   Sia et al., Gastroenterology 2017 (immune class; active vs exhausted)
#   Haber et al., Gastroenterology 2023 (11-gene IFN signature, anti-PD-1 response)
#   Zhu et al., Nat Med 2022 (atezolizumab-bevacizumab: Teff, VEGFR2, Treg, myeloid)
